enter_sequence.speaker: HAYES
enter_sequence.text: On the ground. Hands where I can see them. This is still my house.

defeat_sequence.speaker: HAYES
defeat_sequence.text: I locked up whoever the Six pointed at. Your people got buried under paperwork and broken ribs.

defeat_sequence.speaker: HAYES
defeat_sequence.text: Order ain't pretty. Somebody has to hold the line while the city pretends it's clean.

defeat_sequence.speaker: HAYES
defeat_sequence.text: Execute me and every guard on payroll goes loud. Spare me and I open the south wing — quiet.
